prompt: Create a 9:16 experimental character poster featuring a close-up or waist-up portrait with a strong, confident pose. Build the main portrait in stark black and white with a visible vintage halftone print texture. Keep the face detailed with smaller dots, while using heavier halftone patterns across the hair, jacket and darker areas. Introduce a single sharp color strip cutting through the portrait — across the eyes, cheek and hand. Inside this strip, show realistic high-resolution photography with cool skin tones, subtle blue-grey shadows and natural facial details. Integrate large condensed typography directly into the artwork. Allow parts of the letters to disappear beyond the edges, overlap the subject and interact with the color strip. Use a minimal palette of black, white and grey, with restrained electric blue and deep burgundy accents. Add a few subtle graphic marks: thin technical lines, small circles, registration marks and labels like “VISUAL TRACE”, “SUBJECT 01” and “SIGNAL FOUND”. Make it feel like an underground fashion editorial mixed with a photocopied art zine and experimental character archive. Avoid excessive glitch effects, warm color grading, multiple color windows, floating objects, complicated interface elements, long text, logos, watermarks or decorative sparkles.

promptZh: 创建一个 9:16 实验性角色海报，展示特写或半身肖像，呈现出坚定自信的姿态。主体肖像采用鲜明的黑白风格，并带有明显的复古半色调印刷纹理。面部细节需使用较细的网点，而头发、夹克及阴影区域则使用较粗的半色调图案。引入一个 单一鲜明的色彩条 贯穿肖像——横跨眼睛、脸颊和手部。在此色彩条内，展示高分辨率的写实摄影效果，呈现冷色调皮肤、微妙的蓝灰色阴影以及自然的脸部细节。将大号紧凑型排版直接融入艺术作品中。让部分字母延伸至画面边缘之外、与主体重叠，并与色彩条产生互动。使用黑、白、灰的极简色调，辅以克制的电光蓝和深酒红色点缀。添加一些微妙的图形标记：细线条、小圆圈、套准标记以及诸如 “VISUAL TRACE”、“SUBJECT 01” 和 “SIGNAL FOUND” 之类的标签。营造出一种地下时尚杂志与复印艺术刊物及实验性角色档案相结合的氛围。避免使用过度的故障效果、暖色调分级、多个彩色窗口、浮动对象、复杂的界面元素、长文本、Logo、水印或装饰性闪光。
